data.text: Fertilization occurs when a bird, insect, or the wind transfers a pollen grain from the anther of one plant to the stigma of another plant.

When the pollen grain lands on the stigma it germinates in the pistil and forms a pollen tube. The pollen tube extends to the ovary where it fertilizes the ovule. The fertilized ovule becomes the seed.
The ovary is part of the female reproductive system and contains ovules.
